name: Academic
description: Librarians, archaeologists, and scholars — a life spent in research and study.

bonusFeatChoices.name: Educated
bonusFeatChoices.description:
Benefit: Pick two Knowledge skills. The character gets a +2 bonus on all checks with those skills.
Special: A character can select this feat as many as seven times. Each time, the character selects two new Knowledge skills.

bonusFeatChoices.name: Studious
bonusFeatChoices.description: Benefit: The character gets a +2 bonus on all Decipher Script checks and Research checks.
